The Chinese characters for Michael

As a transliteration, Michael is usually written 迈克尔 (Mài kè ěr). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

迈
Mài
stride
克
kè
overcome, gram
尔
ěr

Origin and meaning

Michael comes from Hebrew and means “who is like God?”.

About the name Michael

The archangel Michael, who leads heaven's armies, is the name's great bearer.

As a gift or a tattoo

The name Michael suits a framed gift, and the clean high-resolution file also works as a tattoo design.
